lines.text: Can you help me? You bet!

data.define: Used to answer yes or say you're welcome.

example.text: Can you help me? You bet!

misuse.text: Don't say 'you bet' when you really can't.

publish.title: What does "you bet" mean?
publish.value: You bet = Sure, of course. Example: "Can you help me? You bet!" (casual English, US).
